subject: Workspace kickoff — credential handoff & admin roster sync
messages:
From: Ella Turner <ella.turner@novexhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Workspace kickoff — credentials & admin roles

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team here at Novex is ready to start the org activation. Our security team is asking for a proposed pattern for: API key distribution (service-account vs user API keys), short-lived key rotation, and a recommended admin invite roster (who gets org-admin vs billing-only).

We're aiming to have the initial workspace live and a seeded service account by Feb 18. Primary contacts: Samir Patel (IT) and me. Can you share a step-by-step handoff plan and who on your side will own the provisioning? Also, if you have a minimal evidence pack for our security review (MOP or checklist), that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to the plan.

— Ella Turner
Director, Digital Platforms
Novex Health
ella.turner@novexhealth.com
Attachment: novex_initial_requirements.xlsx (stub)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Turner <ella.turner@novexhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Workspace kickoff — credentials & admin roles

Hi Ella — great to hear Novex is ready. High level plan below; I copied the implementation leads so we can execute.

1) Roles & invites (Laura) — collect admin roster from you, invite org-admins + billing-only as separate groups; we recommend limiting org-admins to 3 people initially.
2) Service account + API key (Ben & Rishi) — we will seed a dedicated service account for Novex with scoped permissions for ingestion and inference. We will create two keys: a short-lived service key (recommended primary) and a long-lived rotation-only key for emergency rollback. Rishi will provide rotation cadence and sample scripts.
3) Evidence & MOP (Monica) — attaching a short MOP v1 and an admin roster template for your team to complete.
4) Timeline — seed workspace and invite admins by Feb 17; handover call Feb 18 to validate integration.

Attachments: novex_mop_v1.pdf, admin-roster-template.csv

Next steps for you: send the admin roster CSV with names and emails; Samir, if you want a separate security call please propose times.

I'll follow up with an internal task list with owners.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Novex workspace handoff — task split

Team — following up with the plan I sent to Novex. Please ack and call out blockers. Short bullets: 

- Laura: invite cadence & admin buckets. Deliverable: invite emails + list by EOD Feb 16.
- Ben: provision Novex service-account namespace (project: novex-prod) and seed initial service key with minimal perms. Deliverable: service account created and key stub for handoff by Feb 17.
- Rishi: rotation policy and sample rotation script (we prefer 24h short-lived token + weekly rotation of emergency key). Deliverable: rotation script + policy doc by Feb 17.

Cc'ing the Novex contact in the external thread once we have the roster. If anything needs Legal (SLA/terms), flag it — but this is standard onboarding.

Thanks —
Monica

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Novex workspace handoff — task split

Monica — ack. Quick notes from infra side:

- I'll generate a scoped short-lived key mechanism (JWT-based rotation hook) that issues 24h tokens for service usage and rotates the emergency key weekly.
- For Novex we should enable KV prefix caching on the service account to keep token count low and avoid cold starts on small bursts.
- I'll prepare a one-page runbook with sample curl + Python snippets for their SREs.

No blockers. Will deliver rotation script and runbook by COB Feb 17.

— Rishi

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Novex workspace handoff — task split

Ben here — confirmed. I'll provision the project namespace "novex-prod" and create the service account novex-service@novex-prod.redwood (stub). I will seed the first service key and mark it as rotation-only in our tenant console.

I'll also map the minimum RBAC: 
- ingestion role: read/write to ingestion queue
- inference role: inference-only token, no billing permissions
- admin role: full workspace admin

Expect provisioning and key stub by Feb 17 morning. If Laura needs an invite id to link the service account, I'll include it in the handoff note.

— Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Turner <ella.turner@novexhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novexhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.bennett@redwood.ai>

- Proposed handover call: Thu, Feb 18 at 10:00 PT — quick 30m to validate keys in staging and walk through rotation. Please confirm.
